{{Otheruses|Chief Administrator}}
'''Chief Administrator''' was the title used by [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] when he controlled the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].

In the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was the title used by the first assistant of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] ands [[Governor/Legends|governors]]. Until [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Vilim Disra]] was the Chief Administrator of [[Shelsha sector/Legends|Shelsha sector]], under Governor [[Barshnis Choard]].<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref> Additionally, Chief Administrator was the title of [[Maw Installation]]'s research facilities head, which [[Tol Sivron]] served as until his death and the destruction of the facility in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="COF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

The leader of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]] held the title "Chief Administrator," and individuals were elected to the position by the world's [[Corporate Committee]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
